parentSaasRules.rule: ScaleOps is the parent SaaS ecosystem.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not treat ProofArena as parent.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not treat proofarena as parent.

parentSaasRules.rule: ProofArena is a flagship module, not a standalone project.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not create ProofArena app, repo, server, or package.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Verify target remains inside current client/server.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not create proofarena app, repo, server, or package.

parentSaasRules.rule: The existing repository remains source of truth.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not scaffold a replacement root.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Inspect Git root and live paths first.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not scaffold a replacement root.

parentSaasRules.rule: ProofArena uses ScaleOps routing, auth, layout, API, dashboard, and navigation governance.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not add platform substitutes.

parentSaasRules.rule: No ProofArena route tree exists outside central route governance.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not add module router or duplicate constants.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Validate routes, guards, aliases, and navigation.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not add module router or duplicate constants.

parentSaasRules.rule: No ProofArena dashboard/layout shell bypasses role layouts.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not add parallel role shell.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not add parallel role shell.

parentSaasRules.rule: No ProofArena navigation/sidebar stack may be created.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not add module primary navigation.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Validate central config and role filtering.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not add module primary navigation.

parentSaasRules.rule: No ProofArena API client may be created.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Validate central client, endpoints, services, contracts.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not add transport/token/error stack.

parentSaasRules.rule: No ProofArena auth/role system may be created.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not add provider, token store, guard, or middleware bypass.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Validate shared session and backend authorization.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not add provider, token store, guard, or middleware bypass.

parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not move product logic into shared foundations.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Validate import direction and semantic equivalence.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not move product logic into shared foundations.

parentSaasRules.rule: External consumers use the ProofArena public module surface.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not import private module files.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Search imports and run boundary checker.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not import private module files.

parentSaasRules.rule: Boundary reversal requires a formal future ADR and human approval.
parentSaasRules.forbiddenAction: Do not reverse through feature prompt.
parentSaasRules.requiredValidation: Require ADR, impact analysis, migration, rollback, approval.
parentSaasRules.stopCondition: Stop when do not reverse through feature prompt.
